description: For hosts: turns a plan into a filled-in Catch of a Lifetime outing. Returns a link that opens the app's Plan an outing screen with the name, time, length, meeting spot, group size, notes and weekly repeat already set, plus a conditions check when it's within a week. Nothing is posted until the host taps Post. Times accept "9am", "6:30 pm", "sunrise", "sunset" or "full dark".

activity.description: What it is, e.g. "sunrise hike", "fly fishing", "kayak", "pickleball open play", "cars and coffee".

ask_before_join.description: Host approves each person who joins.

date.description: "tomorrow", a weekday, "this weekend" or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the coming Saturday.

duration_minutes.description: How long. Snapped to 1, 2, 3, 4 hours or all day.

group_size.description: Max people. Snapped to 4, 6, 10 or no limit.

latitude.description: Latitude of the exact spot (trailhead, put-in, lake). Use with longitude for anywhere in the US.

metro.description: Launch metro or nearby city, e.g. "Johnson City", "Knoxville", "Denver".

notes.description: Pace, what to bring, parking. Omit for sensible defaults.

place.description: Meeting spot, e.g. "Buffalo Mountain Park lower lot".

price.description: For approved Pro hosts only, e.g. "$45 per person, pay at the trailhead".

title.description: Name for the outing. Omit to get a good default.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP, so people nearby see it. Omit to use the host's own ZIP.

name: draft_outing
title: Draft an Outing
